executive_assessment.text: The CCDR’s cited projection shows land in Côte d’Ivoire rated over 50% suitable for cocoa falling by 57% in the 2050s, while lower-suitability classes expand.
NDC 3.0 plans northern pastoral measures, forest-zone agroforestry and coastal-erosion protection; these are not evaluated results.

geographic_notes.text: Northern Côte d’Ivoire; Rural communities; Southward migration routes: The CCDR says climate-related migration and more intense drought could add to north–south movement and herder–farmer competition over scarce land and water, with potential stability and recruitment implications in vulnerable rural areas.
Abidjan: The CCDR reports severe flooding in Abidjan in June 2018, with more than 20 deaths, and identifies low-lying informal settlements and poorer residents among those exposed.
Northern Côte d’Ivoire; Forest zones; Coastal areas: NDC 3.0 plans northern pastoral measures, forest-zone agroforestry and coastal-erosion protection; these are not evaluated results.
